title: Discipline Lead – Showset (BIM)
purpose: Accountable for quality, completeness, and consistency of Showset-specific BIM content as it relates to showset and documentation delivery. Represents discipline authority for documentation outcomes derived from BIM, ensuring Showset models are fit for drawings, sheets, and documentation outputs within governed workflows.
authority_statements: Approve or reject Showset discipline BIM states for use in showset and documentation milestones
Acts as Showset discipline sign-off authority for documentation readiness
Authority operates strictly within Showset scope and within enterprise standards and BEP
Does not manage cross-discipline governance or alter enterprise standards
Does not hold contractual acceptance authority
responsibilities: Ensure Showset BIM models support accurate, coordinated, and repeatable showset documentation
Identify and address documentation issues traceable to Showset BIM via coordination workflows and data monitoring
Align Showset resources with BIM and documentation milestones in TIDP
Evaluate coordination responses to preserve documentation intent and drawing quality
Formally approve Showset BIM models for documentation use based on externalized monitoring data
Review Showset data completeness using CSV/Excel extracts
accountabilities: Suitability of Showset BIM content for reliable and consistent documentation outputs
Showset participation in BIM workflows affecting showset delivery
Ensuring Showset BIM outputs meet defined quality and documentation expectations at milestones
approvals: Showset BIM model states approved for showset and documentation use
Showset drawings, sheets, and documentation packages derived from BIM
inputs: Creative showset designs and concept documentation
BEP and TIDP templates from Project BIM Manager
Coordination issue logs from Project BIM Coordinator
outputs: Showset documentation packages and sheet sets
